svg.title: Video on demand and live streaming on AWS
svg.desc: Video on demand and live streaming on AWS. 13 components in 5 groups. Connections: Content team to Source bucket; Source bucket to AWS Elemental MediaConvert (transcode); AWS Elemental MediaConvert to Output bucket (renditions); Live camera to AWS Elemental MediaLive; AWS Elemental MediaLive to AWS Elemental MediaPackage (HLS); AWS Elemental MediaPackage to AWS Elemental MediaTailor (manifests); Output bucket to Amazon CloudFront; AWS Elemental MediaTailor to Amazon CloudFront; Amazon CloudFront to Viewers (stream); Amazon API Gateway to AWS Lambda; AWS Lambda to Amazon DynamoDB.

text.tspan: VIDEO ON DEMAND AND LIVE STREAMING ON AWS
A VOD lane and a live lane built on AWS Elemental Media Services converge on Amazon CloudFront, with a serverless playback API beside them
